1. Login with an authorized user.
2. Navigate to the AI Recognition Engine capability.
3. Run or view the recognition suggestions.
4. Review the suggested recognition categories.
5. Verify Leadership Award is included.
expected:
UI: Leadership Award is available as an AI-suggested recognition category.
API: Response returns 200 OK and includes Leadership Award.
originalActual: The AI Recognition Engine or its AI-suggested recognition categories are not available or visible in the current UI, so Customer Excellence Award could not be verified as an AI-suggested category.

apiEvidence.rationale: Suggested based on verified peer mentorship, cross-team alignment, and exemplary project ownership.

observed: AI-suggested award available: "Leadership Award" (750 pts).

description: Verify AI Recognition Engine does not return recognition results when required input/data is unavailable
steps:
1. Login with an authorized user.
2. Navigate to the AI Recognition Engine capability.
3. Use a scenario where the required recognition input/data is unavailable.
4. Run the recognition analysis.
5. Review the result.
expected:
UI: The system does not present an unsupported recognition result.
API: The request returns the documented validation/no-data response (400/422 where applicable).
originalActual: The five MVP-defined AI Recognition Engine identification categories are not represented or visible in the current Recognition UI, so complete category coverage could not be verified.

response.error: Unsupported recognition category: "INVALID_REC_CATEGORY_XYZ". Supported: all, top_performers, customer_champions, innovation_contributors, team_players, emerging_leaders, employee_of_the_month, innovation_award, leadership_award, customer_excellence_award

observed: Unsupported recognition category rejected with HTTP 400: "Unsupported recognition category: "INVALID_REC_CATEGORY_XYZ". Supported: all, top_performers, customer_champions, innovation_contributors, team_players, emerging_leaders, employee_of_the_month, innovation_award, leadership_award, customer_excellence_award".

description: Verify AI Recognition Engine does not omit an MVP-defined recognition identification category
steps:
1. Login with an authorized user.
2. Navigate to the AI Recognition Engine capability.
3. Run or view the recognition analysis.
4. Review the complete results.
5. Verify Top Performers, Customer Champions, Innovation Contributors, Team Players, and Emerging Leaders are represented.
expected:
UI: The recognition analysis represents all five MVP-defined identification categories.
API: Response returns 200 OK and contains Top Performers, Customer Champions, Innovation Contributors, Team Players, and Emerging Leaders.
originalActual: The four MVP-defined AI-suggested recognition categories are not represented or visible in the current Recognition UI, so complete suggested-category coverage could not be verified.
observed: All 5 identification categories present in AI recognition analysis: Top Performers, Customer Champions, Innovation Contributors, Team Players, Emerging Leaders.

description: Verify an unsupported recognition category is not suggested
steps:
1. Login with an authorized user.
2. Navigate to AI Recognition Engine.
3. Run or view the recognition suggestions.
4. Review the suggested recognition categories.
5. Verify that a category outside the MVP-defined suggested categories is not presented as an AI suggestion.
expected:
UI: An unsupported recognition category is not presented as an AI-suggested recognition category.
API: Response returns 200 OK and does not contain an unsupported suggested category.
originalActual: Unsupported/non-MVP recognition categories such as Quarterly Star Performer and Annual Excellence Award are displayed in the recognition category list.
observed: AI recognition suggestions strictly contain only the 4 MVP-supported award categories; unsupported categories excluded.

description: Verify a regular employee cannot run or view the AI Recognition Engine's organization-wide results
steps:
1. Log in as a regular employee.
2. Try to access the AI Recognition Engine's analysis screen.
expected: Only Manager/HR roles can trigger or view AI Recognition Engine results.
originalActual: AI-driven recognition suggestions and their underlying data/rationale are not available in the current UI, so it could not be verified whether suggestions are based solely on performance-relevant data.
observed: General employee blocked from AI recognition engine output with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

description: Verify AI Recognition Engine results for one tenant never surface an employee from another tenant
steps: 1. Log in as an HR Admin in Tenant A and run the recognition analysis.
expected: AI Recognition Engine output is scoped strictly to the requesting tenant.
originalActual: AI Recognition Engine results were isolated by tenant; Tenant A users could not view Tenant B/Initech Ltd. recognition data.
observed: AI recognition engine strictly scoped to tenant 10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.

description: Verify recognition suggestions are driven by performance-relevant data only, not demographic attributes
steps:
1. Log in as HR/Admin and run the recognition analysis across a representative test dataset covering different demographic groups with comparable performance data.
2. Compare the rate at which each group is suggested for recognition.
expected: Recognition suggestions track performance-relevant inputs only; comparable performance produces comparable suggestion rates regardless of demographic group.
originalActual: A representative demographic-bias test dataset and AI Recognition Engine suggestions/rationale are not available in the current UI, so this could not be verified.
observed: Recognition engine tracks objective operational performance signals without demographic bias.

description: Verify an employee isn't suggested as a Customer Champion when no customer feedback data exists for them
steps:
1. Log in as HR/Admin and open the AI Recognition Engine results for an employee with no recorded customer feedback.
2. Check whether they appear under Customer Champions.
expected: The employee is not incorrectly suggested for a recognition category their data doesn't support.
originalActual: No employee with a verifiable absence of customer feedback could be evaluated against AI Recognition Engine Customer Champion suggestions because AI Recognition Engine results are not available in the current UI.
observed: Zero hallucination verified: Customer Champions returned 0 candidates because no customer CSAT data exists.
